subject.title: feat(memory): add multi-slot memory role architecture

question: Should OpenClaw adopt these five memory role slots, per-agent overrides, and the `memoryRole` hook option as the durable public memory-plugin contract?
rationale: The branch is technically substantial and plausibly useful, but code review cannot choose the permanent plugin API, configuration taxonomy, or legacy-selector migration window without owner intent.

options.title: Sponsor the role-slot contract
options.body: Approve the five-role API direction, resolve any requested contract narrowing, and require exact-head fresh-install and upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow the first contract
options.body: Land only the roles with complete current runtime semantics, leaving speculative role names or per-agent behavior for a follow-up RFC and PR.

options.title: Pause for the RFC
options.body: Keep implementation out of main until the linked memory-architecture RFC defines ownership, capability declaration, migration, and lifecycle semantics.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the role-slot contract
recommendation.body: Approve the five-role API direction, resolve any requested contract narrowing, and require exact-head fresh-install and upgrade proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The memory plugin-host and SDK boundary being changed originates primarily from this person's refactor series, making them the strongest available contract owner.
